name: Resistive heating
description: Heating from the current through a motor's windings (I²R): the target's temperature changes at Winding resistance × current² / Thermal capacitance. Connect it from a Motor (it reads the Armature current) to a Thermal mass (it changes the Temperature). Winding resistance (Ω, default 2) is the resistance the current heats. Thermal capacitance (J/K, default 50) is how much heat the housing needs to warm by one kelvin; use the housing's own value.
